## Role in the Rating Process

Eurostat is the statistical office of the European Union. It supplies essential data for the Minimal Rating Process (MRP) and the Discretionary Adjustments Process (DAP). Eurostat publishes the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) used for the [Inflation Differential](../parameters/inflation-differential.qmd) (C2). It provides government debt and deficit statistics, including notifications for excessive deficit procedures, which feed into [Fiscal Capacity](../parameters/fiscal-capacity.qmd) (C3) and [Refinancing Need](../parameters/refinancing-need.qmd) (R1), specifically the DAP task R1-E*. Eurostat also publishes unit-labour-cost-based real effective exchange rates, supporting assessments of competitiveness gaps under [Growth](../parameters/growth.qmd) (C1-A2*) and [Inflation Differential](../parameters/inflation-differential.qmd) (C2-M*).

- [Eurostat](../institutions/eurostat.qmd) data is used for government debt statistics, including the Maastricht definition and non-EDP liabilities, in the [Debt Sustainability Monitor](../document-types/debt-sustainability-monitor.qmd). <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 79, p. 81" aria-label="Source: ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 79, p. 81">ⓘ</button>
